# Render

Render is **upstream Blender** (Ubuntu `blender` 5.0.1, GPL-3.0-or-later) plus the **`amerika_render` add-on**,
a launcher, an Amerika theme, splash and startup file. It is not a source fork. "Blender" is a trademark of the Blender
Foundation; Amerika Render is not affiliated with or endorsed by it (notice in About, `NOTICE`, package copyright).

## Files

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `src/os/render/amerika_render/` | the add-on (legacy `bl_info` + `blender_manifest.toml` for the 4.2+ extension format) |
| `src/os/render/bin/amerika-render` | launcher: `BLENDER_USER_RESOURCES=~/.config/amerika-render`, `BLENDER_SYSTEM_SCRIPTS=/usr/share/amerika-render/scripts`, `--python startup/amerika_startup.py`; copies `splash.png` (user datafiles) and `startup.blend` on first run |
| `src/os/render/startup/amerika_startup.py` | enables the add-on, applies the theme, opens the **Amerika** workspace |
| `src/os/render/theme/amerika.xml`, `data/splash.png`, `data/startup.blend`, `icons/amerika-render.svg` | generated by `tools/make_theme.py`, `tools/make_assets.py`, `tools/make_startup.py` (committed) |
| `tools/builders/render.py` | builds `amerika-render` (arch all; Depends `amerika-studio (>= v)`, `blender (>= 5.0)`, `python3`, `python3-numpy`) |
| `tests/test_studio_render.py` | unit tests + real headless Blender runs |

Installed: `/usr/bin/amerika-render`, `/usr/share/amerika-render/{scripts/addons/amerika_render,startup,theme,extension,NOTICE,splash.png,startup.blend}`,
desktop entry `amerika-render.desktop`, icon in hicolor. An extension zip (`extension/amerika_render-<v>.zip`) allows "Install from Disk" in stock Blender.

## Add-on

* **UI**: 3D Viewport sidebar tab **Amerika** (chat, Send/Ask popup `Ctrl+Alt+A`, Stop, model choice, *Review code before it runs* (default ON), *Review every change*,
  Workflows, Undo last request, activity log). The **Amerika workspace** shows the same panels in a wide Properties editor (Scene tab) beside the viewport
  (Blender cannot select a sidebar tab from Python, hence the Properties editor).
* **Bridge**: only `http://127.0.0.1:18890/v1/messages` (`AMERIKA_STUDIO_BRIDGE` may point at another loopback port, anything else is refused), header
  `X-Amerika-App: render`, token from `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/amerika/studio-token` (sent as `Authorization: Bearer` and `X-Amerika-Token`). stdlib `urllib` on a worker thread;
  tool calls run on the main thread through a queue drained by a `bpy.app.timers` timer. No API key anywhere in Blender.
* **Undo**: each request saves a checkpoint `.blend` under `<project>/.amerika-render/checkpoints/` (last 10 kept) and every mutating tool does `ed.undo_push`;
  the `undo` tool supports `steps` or `checkpoint: request_start`; the panel has *Undo last request*.
* **Project folder**: `~/Studio/Render` (`AMERIKA_RENDER_PROJECT` or add-on preference). Import/export/render `save_to` paths are confined (no `..`, no absolute paths outside, symlinks resolved; error `-32003`).

## Tools (model-facing)

`scene_info, create_primitive, transform_object, add_modifier, edit_mesh, create_mesh_from_data, set_material, assign_collection, set_origin, uv_unwrap,
import_file, export_file, set_camera, set_light, set_world, viewport_screenshot, render_preview, delete_object, undo, duplicate_object, set_shading,
check_game_ready, create_armature, pose_keyframes, run_python` (25). Definitions: `toolspecs.py` (JSON schemas, validated by `schema.py`).
Images come back to the model as `image` blocks. `viewport_screenshot` and `render_preview` render through a throw-away scene (the user's scene is untouched);
wireframes are drawn in software (numpy) because Workbench cannot draw them. **Rendering uses CPU Cycles by default**: on the test machine (Adreno/freedreno) the GPU engines
(Workbench, EEVEE) silently dropped objects in headless renders; set `AMERIKA_RENDER_GPU=1` or `engine: eevee` to use the GPU.

`run_python` (risk `critical`): AST check (imports limited to bpy/bmesh/mathutils/math/random/colorsys/itertools/collections/bpy_extras; no `os/sys/subprocess/socket/ctypes`,
`open/eval/exec/compile/__import__/getattr/globals...`, no underscore attributes, no `bpy.ops.wm/script/import_*/export_*`, `bpy.app/utils/path/preferences`, `Image.save`, no classes), a stripped
`__builtins__` with a whitelist import hook, a 20 s trace-based time limit, shown for approval when review is on. This is defence in depth, not a sandbox: keep review ON.

System prompt (`prompt.py`): plan -> scene_info -> build -> screenshot -> critique -> fix, metres/Z-up, naming, game-ready topology and budgets, pivot at base, scale applied,
Godot/glTF conventions, rigs only on request. Workflows (panel buttons and `render.model.*`): Describe a model, Change the model, Make game-ready, Rig basic armature + idle/walk/attack.

## Control endpoint (for local automation)

Started by the add-on in GUI sessions (disable: preference, or `AMERIKA_RENDER_NO_CONTROL=1`). Loopback `127.0.0.1:<free port>`, `POST /rpc`, `Authorization: Bearer <token>`,
JSON-RPC 2.0, Host must be loopback and no `Origin`. Descriptor `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/amerika/studio-render.json` (0600, `{app,url,token,pid,version}`), removed on exit.
Implements the `render.*` tools of `src/os/studio/tools.json`: `scene.info`, `scene.run_python`, `model.create_from_description`, `model.apply_change`, `viewport.screenshot`, `export`
(`glb gltf fbx obj stl blend png`), `app.prompt` (`message`, `timeout_s`), plus `app.ping`, `app.screenshot`, `tools.list` and `tool.<name>` (raw access to every tool, not exposed by MCP).
Images are returned as `{images:[{mime,base64}]}`. Errors: `-32601` method, `-32602` params, `-32001` denied, `-32002` busy, `-32003` path outside project, `-32000` other.
`model.*`/`app.prompt` run the same in-app assistant (visible in the panel, subject to the review toggles) and wait.

## Testing without root

```
apt-get download blender blender-data <missing libs> python3-numpy ; dpkg-deb -x ... ../tools/blender-test/root
```
`../tools/blender-test/blender` (wrapper) sets `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, `BLENDER_SYSTEM_RESOURCES=<root>/usr/lib/blender` and `BLENDER_USER_SCRIPTS` (numpy symlink).
`tests/test_studio_render.py` finds it (or `$AMERIKA_TEST_BLENDER`, or `blender` on PATH) and skips the Blender tests otherwise. GUI checks used a private
`kwin_wayland --virtual` (see `tools/kwin-rig.sh`).

## Known limits

FBX export is absent from Ubuntu's Blender 5.0 build (the tool says so; use glb). Procedural material nodes do not export to glTF. The review code is also mirrored into a Text datablock
"Amerika Review". Real model quality and GPU rendering on the target laptop were not verified.
